found.description: `<command> --version` ran, or the file of the command exists.

provider.description: The new card, with the badge `acp`.

version.description: The first line of the `--version` output, when the command printed one.

AcpAgent.description: An ACP agent that the user added in Settings. Stored with the settings (`Settings::acp`).

env.description: Extra environment variables of the agent process.

id.description: The provider id: `acp-` and the name in lower case.

ActivityRow.description: A row of the activity tab.

ActivitySample.description: One minute of the pulse chart.

waiting.description: Agents that wait for the user, errors included (lower half, orange).

command.description: A program name on the PATH, or the path of a file.

paths.description: Globs relative to the repository root, for example `crates/pay/**`.

AgentRef.description: A provider and a model, for example `claude · opus-5.5`.

AnswerParams.description: Answer an ask: pick an option, or type an own answer, or both.

Ask.description: A question to the user. The first option is the primary button.

id.description: Changes with every new ask, so a late answer cannot hit the next ask.

reason.description: Why the agent asks (phone Approval screen).

risky.description: A risky permission needs a biometric confirmation on the phone.

text.description: The command for a permission (show it in mono), else the question.

AskKind.description: What a session in [`SessionState::NeedsYou`] or [`SessionState::Error`] waits for.

Autopilot.description: The autopilot rules (war-room popover and Settings).

AutopilotPatch.description: Change some autopilot rules. Missing fields keep their value.

Blame.description: Which prompt wrote a line (phone Diff screen, "blame by prompt").

BlameHunk.description: A run of lines with the same commit and the same turn. A hunk of one line is one line.

commit.description: `None`: the lines are not committed yet.

turn.description: `None`: no turn of the ledger wrote these lines (a human, or an unknown tool).

session.description:
The session that owns the uncommitted lines. Without it, only committed lines have a
turn.

BlameTurn.description: The turn that wrote a line.

keys.description: The blocked keys to free. Empty frees every block of the session.

resolved.description: The number of blocks that the call closed.

Board.description:
The computed board of the war room. Every display shows these gates; none computes them.

Gate rule, for live sessions only (`Working`, `NeedsYou`, `Error`, `Idle`):
`NeedsYou` goes to `needs_you`, `Working` to `working`, `Error` to `blocked`, `Idle` to
`idle`. Parked and done sessions are in no gate. In a gate the sessions with an open ask
come first, then the longest wait (the oldest `since`), then the id.

asks.description: The sessions with an open ask, longest wait first.

BoardGate.description: One gate of the board: the count and the session ids.

Claim.description: A lease of a session on a routing key.

leaseS.description: Seconds until the lease ends. A heartbeat of the daemon renews it.

path.description: The file of the key (a path key, or the file of a symbol key when the daemon knows it).

range.description: The lines of the symbol, when the key is a symbol key.

session.description: The session id as the war room shows it.

ClaimList.description: Result of `claims/list`: the live claims, ordered by key and session.

ClaimRange.description: The lines of a changed declaration, from 1, both ends included.

ClaimState.description: The state of a claim. It only moves up: intent, editing, landed.

oneOf.description: The plan of the session will touch the key.
The session changed the key.
The change is on the target branch. It shows no heat.

codebase.description: Only the claims of the sessions of this codebase.

session.description: Only the claims of this session.

diagnostics.description:
The findings in this file: the stored findings of the last turn that changed it in
this session, or the syntax errors of the text.

language.description: The language name (`rust`, `typescript`, ...), or empty for a file without a grammar.

text.description: The whole text, cut at 1 MiB (then `truncated` is true).

lines.description: The lines to highlight (the viewport). Default: lines 1 to 200.

rev.description:
A git revision (`HEAD`, a branch, a commit), or `turn:<n>` with `session`: the snapshot
at the end of turn `n`. Default: the working tree.

oneOf.description: The symbol index (declarations and name references; no type resolution).
A language server.
The syntax tree of the file alone.

Codebase.description: One repository with its parts from `.aivory/map.toml`. The id is the short name.

daemon.description: The daemon that runs the sessions of this codebase.

parts.description: In map order. The Sankey orders its part column by this list.

id.description: The first 12 characters of the commit id.

detail.description: One short line: the description of a command, the folder of a file.

insert.description: The text that replaces the typed word, for example `/review ` or `@src/main.rs `.

label.description: The text of the row, for example `/review` or `src/main.rs`.

oneOf.description: A built-in command of the agent CLI.
A custom command or prompt file of the user or the project.
A skill.
A file or a folder of the codebase.
A subagent.

CompleteKind.description: What the typed word asks for.

oneOf.description: A word that starts with `/` at the start of the message.
A word that starts with `@`.

cwd.description: The folder when there is no session yet.

provider.description: The agent when there is no session yet (`claude`, `codex`, `gemini`).

query.description: The typed word without its `/` or `@`.

session.description: The session of the chat field: it gives the agent and the folder.

ComposerPrefs.description: The dropdowns of a composer. A provider change is a handoff to a new session.

ConsoleBackground.description: Console background of the session panes.

cwd.description:
The working folder of the daemon process: where "Open shell" starts when no codebase is
selected. Empty from an older daemon.

demo.description: The daemon serves the demo data (`aivoryd serve --demo`).

host.description: The name of the machine. Empty from an older daemon.

oneOf.description: This machine.

maxRunning.description: 1-64. The daemon writes it to the autopilot value `maxRunning`.

DagNode.description: A card of the DAG tab. [`crate::layout::dag`] places the cards.

durationMs.description: Known for done and running nodes.

span.description: The span that a click selects.

state.description: Done, working (`running`), needs you (`waiting`) or parked (`planned`).

Delta.description: One change of the war-room view.

oneOf.description: Add a session or replace it (same id).
New transcript lines. Main lines go to the pane tail; subagent lines only count.
A new pulse sample, or a new value for the current minute (same `at`).
Add a codebase or replace it (same id).
A codebase that no longer shows (`repos/remove` of a pinned codebase).
Daemon time, so that the clocks of the clients stay right.

The new board. The daemon sends it after every change of a session. A client that does
not know this delta keeps its old board.

DevicePushParams.description:
Parameters of `devices/push`: where the daemon sends the end-to-end encrypted push of a
paired device.

id.description:
The device id (`device_id` of the pairing). The daemon binds the call to the caller, so a
client may leave it out.

pushKey.description: The X25519 public key of the device for sealed pushes, base64url without padding.

token.description: The APNs hex token or the FCM registration token.

session.description:
With a session: the stored findings of that session. Without it: the daemon runs the
fast stages (syntax and rules) now on the files that changed in the checkout.

turn.description: The turn. Default: the last turn that has stored findings. Needs `session`.

added.description:
In `rows`, not in the state before the turn. `added` and `removed` compare the stages
that ran on both sides (syntax and rules; linters and language servers run only after
the turn).

notes.description: The stages that ran and the notes of the run (skipped tools, truncated stages).

removed.description: In the state before the turn, not in `rows`.

rows.description: The findings after the turn, in the files that the turn changed.

turn.description: The turn of the findings. `None` for a run without a session.

DispatchParams.description:
Start work from one line, or queue it (`session/dispatch`).

Rule: the daemon takes `codebase` (default: the first codebase), `part` (default: the first
part) and `agent` (the provider, default `claude`). When the autopilot has a free slot for
the codebase ([`crate::WarRoom::has_free_slot`]) the daemon starts a session now and the
result holds `session`. Else it queues a task, whatever the autopilot `startQueued` value is,
and the result holds `task`. [`DispatchParams::from_line`] reads the line
`@codebase words --agent provider`.

effort.description: The effort of the session (default: the provider setting).

mode.description: The permission mode of the session (default: the provider setting).

model.description: The model of the session (default: the provider setting).

Dispatched.description: The result of `session/dispatch`: `session` when it started, `task` when it queued.

customTheme.description:
The id of an installed theme package (ADR 0024). `None` uses `look`. Setting
`display.look` clears it. The field serializes as `null`, so `set_key` finds it.

maximizeFullScreen.description: The maximize button of the window opens a borderless full screen. F11 goes back.

perRow.description: Panes per row: 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 9 or 16. `None` is Auto (fits the window width).

uiScale.description: Interface text size in percent of the base sizes, 80-150.

DisplayClass.description: A display class of a layout set.

Empty.description: Parameters of a method without parameters. `null` and `{}` are both valid.

FileNode.description: A row of the file tree.

claimState.description: The state of that session (an orange pill for needs you).

claimedBy.description: The session that claims the file.

part.description: The part tag of a part root.

path.description: Relative to the repository root. Directories end with `/`.

Finding.description: One diagnostic: a row of a SARIF log, without the parts that no client needs.

fingerprint.description:
The stable id of the finding (`aivoryFingerprint/v1`). It stays the same when the
finding moves in its declaration.

rule.description: For example `aivory/syntax-error`, `aivory/long-function`, or a linter rule.

tool.description: The tool that found it: `aivory-syntax`, `aivory-rules`, `clippy`, or a language server.

Fold.description: A range that an editor can fold.

ForkParams.description: Fork a session: a new session that starts with the conversation of the old one.

at.description:
The span to fork at. A daemon that cannot fork at a span forks at the end. A turn
number (`"3"`) forks at the end of that turn of the turn ledger: the new session gets a
worktree at the snapshot of the turn and a handoff packet of the turns 1 to 3.

prompt.description: The first turn of the fork. The daemon picks a neutral one when it is missing.

provider.description: The provider of a fork at a turn. Default: the provider of the old session.

Gate.description: A check before a merge: tests, Guard, build, review.

HandoffParams.description: Continue a session with another provider. The daemon starts a new session with a summary.

Highlight.description: One highlighted token. A token does not cross a line.

HistoryPage.description: Result of `session/history`: lines `start .. start + lines.len()` of `total`.

before.description: Return the lines before this index. Omit it for the newest lines.

HitStatus.description: What a human did about a radar hit.

oneOf.description: A ping went to one of the sessions (`radar/ping`).
One of the sessions paused (`session/pause`).

definitions.description: The definitions, at most 5 (see `code/definition` for all).

name.description: The name under the cursor. Empty when the cursor is not on a name.

range.description: The token under the cursor: its line, start, and end column.

signature.description: The first line of the declaration, when a definition was found.

text.description:
Markdown. The declaration header (`signature`) in a code block, then the doc text when
a language server gave one.

changes.description: The values that changed. Empty when both sides agree.

skipped.description: What the daemon did not import, and why.

InboxItem.description: One thing that needs the user. The first option is the primary button.

agents.description: One agent, or two for a conflict.

ask.description: The ask of that session, if the item answers one.

preview.description: One line for the list card.

result.description: Set when the item is done: `allowed`, `denied`, `approved`, `merged`, ...

session.description: The session that asks (for a conflict: the session that found it).

tail.description: The transcript tail of the session, oldest first.

text.description: The text of the ask card.

done.description: Items done in this daemon run, newest first.

id.description: Omit it to snooze all open items.

edited.description: Files that the user changed since the add.

error.description: The theme is invalid; the app uses Minimal and shows this message.

ItemSource.description: Where the files of an item are: one release asset URL, or a list of raw file URLs.

ItemType.description: The type of a registry item.

JobRef.description: A started job. Poll it with `theme/job`.

JobStatus.description: The state of a job. `result` has the type of the method that started the job.

snapshots.description:
Take a snapshot of the repository at each turn end of a session (hidden commits on
`refs/aivory/turns/...`; the working tree and the index stay as they are).

diagnosticsAdded.description: The findings that the turn added and removed (`code/diagnostics` has the rows).

n.description: The turn number. Turn 0 is the baseline at the start of the session.

snapshot.description: The turn has a snapshot that `ledger/revert` and `code/file` (`rev: "turn:n"`) can use.

Line.description: One transcript line. Clients add the decoration (`› `, `  └ `, `● `, `↳ `, `+ `, `- `).

label.description: The bold head: the tool name, the subagent name, or `TURN n`.

media.description:
An image, a video, a PDF, or a link that the line previews. `text` names it for a
client without previews.

LineKind.description: The kind of a transcript line. The design calls them `x u a t o p m s e h`.

oneOf.description: `x`: meta line (session header, idle marker).
`u`: a user prompt, shown as `› text` on a grey band.
`a`: agent text.
`t`: a tool call, shown as `● Label  text` (bold label, green first letter).
`o`: tool output, shown as `  └ text`.
`p`: an added line, shown as `+ text` (green).
`m`: a removed line, shown as `- text` (red).
`s`: subagent activity, shown as `↳ label  text` (purple).
`e`: an error line (red).
`h`: a turn divider, shown as `label · text` (deep dive transcript).

LineRange.description: A range of lines, from 1, both ends included.

oneOf.description: Not configured.

Look.description:
The look of the whole desktop app (ADR 0022). Each look draws every screen from the same
data. `Display.theme` (light, dark) applies to Minimal only.

oneOf.description: The orchestration board: modules, streams, gates, log, queue, live.
A starship console: big readouts, a schematic, numbered rows.
An operator wall of numbered monitors, one code rain per agent.
A vector city map: one district per codebase, agents move between parts.
A 3D file-system landscape in the style of early-90s workstation software.
See-through glass panels over slow rings; a bloom of strands, one per session.
A phosphor-green radar: bearing is the codebase, range is time since the last move.
A real-time strategy command console: a map of units per codebase, a command sidebar.

MailItem.description: One item of the mailbox of a session.

count.description: The number of pings that merged into this item.

deliveredAt.description: When the daemon put the item in front of an input. Empty while it waits.

digest.description: True for the digest of the pings over the hourly limit.

from.description: The senders, comma separated (a merged ping has several).

resolved.description:
A question that has an answer, a request that has a task, or a block that a human
overrode.

MailList.description: Result of `mail/list`: the mailbox of the session, oldest first.

author.description: The agent that wrote the last version, for example `claude opus-5.5`.

Media.description:
One media item. `src` is an absolute file path on the daemon machine or an `http(s)` URL.
A remote client reads a file through `media/get`.

MediaData.description: The bytes of a media file, as base64.

MediaGetParams.description: `media/get`: read a media file of the daemon machine (a remote client shows a preview).

oneOf.description: A web page.

Memory.description: The RAM of the machine and of the agent processes (`resources/memory`).

agentsMb.description: The RAM of all agent processes (claude, codex, gemini and their node helpers).

samples.description: Oldest first, one sample each few seconds, about 30 minutes.

top.description: The agent processes that use the most RAM, largest first.

ModeParams.description: Set the mode of the composer of a session. It applies from the next turn.

attachments.description:
Files of the first turn. Images (png, jpeg, gif, webp) go to the agent as images;
the client names other files in the prompt.

autopilot.description: A session parks or a queued task starts.

conflict.description: Two sessions edit the same code.

error.description: A session stops on an error.

review.description: A task reaches the review gate.

OrganizerMode.description: What the organizer agent may do.

oneOf.description: It acts: pauses, parks, stops and resumes sessions, sets the autopilot, queues tasks.
It watches RAM and sessions and gives feedback; it does not act.
It watches the sessions only (stuck, waiting, conflicts) and gives feedback.
It watches RAM only and warns when it runs low.

OrganizerStartParams.description: `organizer/start`: start the organizer agent as a session of aivoryd.

codebase.description: The codebase whose folder the agent runs in (default: the first codebase).

composer.description:
Mode, provider, model, and effort of the organizer session. Default: Auto, claude,
the default model, medium effort.

OsEntry.description: The state of the entry in the scheduler of the operating system.

at.description: The fire time that the entry holds.

error.description: Why the entry could not be written.

name.description: The name of the entry, for example `AIVory\s1731150000000`.

scheduler.description:
`windows`, `systemd`, `crontab`, `launchd`, or `none` (the daemon fires it while it
runs).

OutlineNode.description: A node of the structure view.

endLine.description: The last line of the declaration.

startLine.description: The first line of the declaration.

Pane.description: One session as the war room shows it: a pane in the grid, or a chip in the quiet section.

controlled.description:
aivoryd runs the agent process: it can answer an ask, pause and stop. A session that
runs in a terminal is `false`; its asks are answered there.

linesTotal.description: Lines in the full main transcript. `tail` holds the last of them.

since.description: When the session entered `state`. The meta reads `waits N min`, `idle N min` or `N min`.

subagents.description: The subagent switcher (the main agent is implicit).

tail.description: The last lines of the main transcript, oldest first.

task.description: The task that started this session.

tokens.description:
Tokens in and out of the session so far, without prompt-cache reads (the war room
Overview). 0 when unknown.

Part.description: A named slice of a codebase, for example `payment` or `ui`.

paths.description: Glob patterns relative to the repository root.

PartStats.description: A row of the parts table.

oneOf.description: Information, shown at the next turn boundary.
A question with a deadline.
A request for work. The daemon makes a task.

"Stop changing X until Y lands". The daemon denies the edits of the receiver on the
keys until a human overrides it with `block/override`. Only a human sends a block.

PinnedRepo.description: A codebase that the user registered. The daemon scans it without a session.

Place.description: A place in a file, with the text of its line.

len.description: The length of the name in bytes, when the engine knows it.

preview.description:
The text of the line, trimmed, at most 160 characters. Empty when the file is not
readable.

indexing.description: The index of the codebase is not complete yet: ask again in a moment.

name.description: The name under the cursor that the query used.

ProjectNewParams.description:
Parameters of `project/new`: create `<parent>/<name>`, run `git init`, write the template
and `.aivory/map.toml`, and register the folder as a codebase.

name.description: The folder name, also the codebase id. No path separators.

oneOf.description: `README.md` and `.gitignore`.
Plus `Cargo.toml` and `src/main.rs`.
Plus `package.json` and `index.js`.
Plus `pyproject.toml` and `main.py`.

auth.description: The auth line, for example `subscription · Max · signed in`.

monogram.description: One letter for the card monogram.

oneOf.description: An ACP agent.

PushPlatform.description: The push service of a phone.

RadarHit.description: A pair of sessions that change the same code.

at.description: When the radar found the pair.

conflictFiles.description: The files with a text conflict (the trial merge).

keys.description: The keys that caused the match, sorted.

score.description:
The risk: 0.1 clean merge with no shared symbol, 0.4 shared symbols, 0.7 a signature
that the other side uses, 1.0 a text conflict.

status.description: What a human did about the pair. `None` for a new pair.

tier.description: The highest tier that matched: 1 same path, 2 same symbol, 3 dependency.

trialError.description: Why no trial merge ran, when `trial` is false.

RadarNode.description: A session in the radar graph.

owner.description: The owner of the session: `you`, or a team member in the team scope.

Parameters of `radar/ping` (and its alias `mail/send`). A ping without `from` comes from the
human at the client.

from.description: The sender: a session id. Omit it for a human.

keys.description:
The routing keys that the ping is about. Pings with the same key and kind in 10 minutes
merge into one. A block needs at least one key.

RegistryEntry.description: A registry of the user, with the items of the last refresh.

refreshedAt.description: Unix ms of the last refresh. `None`: never refreshed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive, in lowercase hex.

name.description: One registry, or all when absent.

Remote.description: Settings of the remote link and the phone push.

pushUrl.description: The URL of the push gateway (`https://.../v1/push`). Empty: no push to the phones.

relay.description:
The relay of the iroh link: a URL, `default` (the iroh relays), or `none`. Empty means
`default`. `aivoryd serve --relay` wins over this value.

clearedCurrent.description: The theme was the current theme; `display.customTheme` is clear now.

RenamePreview.description: Result of `code/rename`. The daemon never applies the edits.

exact.description:
`false` for an answer of the index: it renames every use of the name, also in
unrelated scopes. A language server gives exact edits.

path.description: A folder inside a git repository. The daemon registers the root of the repository.

turn.description: Undo this turn: the working tree of the session returns to the snapshot before it.

restored.description: The turn number of the snapshot that the working tree has now.

snapshot.description: The first 12 characters of the snapshot commit.

cron.description:
Five fields in local time: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week (0 = Sunday).
Each field: `*`, a number, a range `1-5`, a list `1,15`, and a step `*/15`.

lastTask.description: The task of the last fire.

nextFire.description: `None` when the schedule is off or the expression never matches.

ScheduleFireParams.description:
`schedules/fire`: the entry of the operating system calls it. `due` is the fire time that
the entry was for: a fire that the daemon did already is not repeated.

attachments.description: Paths of attached files and screen captures.

composer.description: New mode, model or effort for this turn. A new provider needs `session/handoff`.

subagent.description: Send to this subagent instead of the main agent.

SessionDiff.description: Result of `session/diff`: the diff of the session worktree.

SessionState.description:
The one status model of all screens. The declaration order is the display order
(needs you first). The design calls the states `q e w i p d`.

oneOf.description: Waits for an answer (`q`): permission, plan or question.
Stopped on an error (`e`).
Runs (`w`).
Live, but waits for a task (`i`).
Stopped and resumable (`p`). On the task board: planned.
Finished (`d`).

SessionStats.description: The stats strip of the deep dive.

spans.description: Parents before children, siblings by start time.

Settings.description: Everything that `settings/set` can change. Changes save at once.

acp.description: The ACP agents of the user (`providers/addAcp`). Each one shows as a provider card.

coffeeReminder.description: One quiet coffee hint per app start. Old JSON has no value: on.

pinned.description: The codebases of the user (`repos/add`): the daemon scans them without a session.

tokensIn.description: Input tokens, including the cache reads and cache writes of the call.

tool.description: The tool id for a tool span, for example `bash` or `file_edit`.

oneOf.description: Autopilot starts it when a slot is free.

Step.description: One step of the playbook stepper.

oneOf.description: Waits for the user.

task.description: What the main agent asked it to do.

cursor.description: The last `seq` the client applied. Omit it for a fresh snapshot.

signature.description: The declaration header on one line.

query.description: A name, a prefix, or a few letters in order (`inv` finds `Invoice`).

agents.description: The provider of each agent that works on the task (the provider circles).

waitingFor.description: Why the task waits (the orange wait reason).

composer.description:

provider.description: Default: the provider defaults of Settings.

TaskPriority.description: How soon a queued task starts when the autopilot order is `Priority`.

native.description:

session.description: The session to open. Subagent rows open their parent session.

composer.description: Default: the provider defaults of Settings.

TaskTemplate.description: What a fire creates: a task with its first session.

composer.description: Default: the provider defaults of Settings.

TextEdit.description: One text edit. The range is in the old text.

layouts.description: The `root` node of each screen of the class, by screen name.

parts.description: The `root` node of each part, by name.

preview.description: The path of `previews/<class>.png` when the theme has it.

file.description: The path below the theme folder, for `theme/asset`.

ThemeGetParams.description: `theme/get`: one installed theme for one display class.

ThemeSourceParams.description: `theme/inspect`: a source such as `github:owner/repo@v1.0.0` or a GitHub release URL.

Timeline.description: Result of `ledger/timeline`: the events of one file, oldest first.

TimelineEvent.description: One event of the history of a file.

turns.description: The turns that the commit carries (the `Aivory-Turns` trailer).

added.description: The lines of this file that the turn added and removed.

TokenKind.description: The kind of a highlighted token.

TurnFileStat.description: A file that a turn changed.

TurnId.description: A turn in a timeline or a commit.

UsageWindow.description: A provider usage window, for example `claude 5 h window 62%`.

estimate.description: The value comes from local transcripts, not from the provider. Show "estimate".

resetsAt.description: When the window frees up: the oldest counted call leaves it. `None` when unknown.

used.description: Tokens counted in the window (0 when unknown).

WarRoom.description:
The complete war-room view. `warroom/snapshot` returns it; `warroom/subscribe` keeps it
current with [`crate::rpc::Delta`]s.

board.description:
The gates of the board and the order of the asks. The daemon computes it
([`WarRoom::compute_board`]) and keeps it current with [`crate::rpc::Delta::Board`].
Old JSON has no board: empty.

cursor.description: The sequence number of the last delta in this view.

epoch.description: Changes when the daemon restarts. A cursor is valid only with its epoch.

queued.description: Tasks that wait for a free autopilot slot.

sessions.description: Live, parked and done sessions, in a stable order.
